description: Accountable-human draft-design authority and the no-conflict policy basis are directly confirmed for the current INTAKE package, but final author order, corresponding-author identity, affiliation wording, institutional endorsement, execution, external sharing, submission, and scientific verification remain separately gated
mitigation: Preserve the confirmed draft-design authority boundary and require separate accountable decisions for final metadata, institutional endorsement, execution, external sharing, submission, and scientific verification
trigger: Any attempt to treat draft-design authority as execution, external-sharing, or submission approval

description: Broad novelty is already rejected and the narrow REFRAME claim remains unresolved after bounded prior-art, patent, and standards-adjacent review
mitigation: Preserve narrow claim-safe wording, complete citation-chain closure, and require independent novelty verification before broadening language
verification: Updated research-case/01-novelty/novelty-matrix.csv plus independent scientific verification event
trigger: New manuscript or feasibility wording exceeds the narrow claim

description: Existing exploratory or internal results could leak into confirmatory thresholds or stronger manuscript wording
mitigation: Freeze protocol, analysis plan, progression criteria, and stop rules before any confirmatory rerun; keep current results planning-only
verification: Dated 03-design package showing thresholds were fixed before rerun
trigger: A threshold or claim is chosen after outcome inspection

description: Selective withholding lets custodians pass canary audits yet fail targeted disputes, limiting any stronger readiness claim
mitigation: Keep the counterexample as a preserved negative result and cap claims to present-readiness proxy language only
verification: Confirmatory reproduction of prototype/results/selective_withholding.csv and manuscript non-claim language
trigger: Audit success is described as future-dispute guarantee

description: Distributed deadline behavior is still unmeasured under representative multi-process or multi-machine latency, loss, and crash conditions
mitigation: Run a bounded synthetic distributed benchmark with frozen synchrony assumptions before any stronger deadline or accountability wording
verification: Pilot traces and benchmark report under a frozen environment and fault profile
trigger: Deadline or accountability claim goes beyond local toy evidence

description: Formal proof completion and independent threshold-cryptography review remain incomplete
mitigation: Complete proof obligations or narrow the claims, then obtain an external cryptography review
trigger: A theorem-level claim is made without completed proof or review

description: Core evidence has same-workspace reproduction but lacks clean-machine or independently operated reproduction
mitigation: Run an independent reproduction from authoritative inputs and compare hashes and key results within declared tolerances
verification: Independent reproduction report with manifests and hashes
trigger: A result is treated as robust beyond the original workspace

description: Dealer-based setup and experimental refresh are not production DKG or PVSS evidence
mitigation: Keep dealer setup as a research substitution and preserve the production DKG or PVSS boundary in all claims
verification: Manuscript and report wording retain the non-production boundary
trigger: Production-security or deployment wording drifts into the artifact

description: Failure-domain labels, outage assumptions, or placement constraints may not match real deployments closely enough for operational guidance
mitigation: Declare domain-model inputs, run sensitivity analysis, and remove operational recommendations that depend on unsupported metadata
verification: Sensitivity results plus external operator or systems review
trigger: Correlation results are used for deployment guidance

description: The bulletin-board contract is a research-only ledger boundary and lacks an independent security audit or on-chain proof verification
mitigation: Keep the contract framed as a research boundary and require an independent security review before production evolution claims
verification: External security review memo or maintained research-only scope
trigger: The contract is described as production-ready or as proof-complete

description: Current venue, artifact, and reporting requirements remain unresolved for the eventual full paper
mitigation: Verify the target venue, artifact rules, and reporting obligations before manuscript integration or submission-readiness claims
verification: Dated venue and reporting requirements check
trigger: A full-paper-ready claim is made without venue verification
